identitySignals: Name matches the agenda vendor: the website fairschools.org belongs to an education consulting company called 'Fair Schools'.
The company's services (leadership coaching, professional learning, curriculum and instruction support for schools) fit an Academics and Instruction Department agreement.
The listed phone number has a 510 area code, which covers the East Bay including Oakland. This is a weak signal, and the page never names a city.
research.notes: Not confirmed as the Oakland vendor. The website does not name a city, and I found no registry record (California Secretary of State, SAM.gov) or OUSD page that ties this organization to the agenda item. Search tools hit their usage limit before I could check registries. The legal entity name, address, headquarters and registry IDs are left null. A reviewer should confirm the Oakland location and the legal name before publishing. The site's other pages could not be fetched.

profile.summary: Fair Schools is a Black-owned education consulting company that supports school leaders and schools. It offers professional development, content development, and strategy development and implementation. Its stated focus is reducing the disproportionate placement of Black and Latino students and multilingual learners in special education.
